title: Great bell, NO certificate of authenticiy
text: Great bell, NO certificate of authenticiy. The bell itself is stunning, it's heavy and has a genuinely magical ring. I know my daughter will cherish it forever, and I am glad that I bought it. After reading a few other reviews I decided to open the box before putting it under the tree to make sure everything was as expected. I'm glad I did, because there was no certificate of authenticity. Some may think I'm being a little bit too particular taking away 2 stars because of a missing piece of paper, so I'll explain my rationale.  When my daughter asked Santa for a bell from his sleigh for Christmas I had a slight panic attack. How could I possibly get something like that?  Fortunately I decided to search on Amazon since they literally have everything and what do you know, I found it! There were 3 different bells I was interested in, and honestly the certificate of authenticity was what made this product stand out from the others. It seemed like the perfect touch. Including shipping, I paid over $40 for a bell. I truly don't mind spending the extra money to get something that will be cherished for a lifetime, and the quality of this bell exceeded all expectations. But when you spend that kind of money, you expect to get exactly what you paid for and exactly what is supposed to be in the package. I do plan on making my own certificate to put in the box and obviously a 5 year old will never know the difference, but there's no way to get a gold seal and I have no time to get nice paper to print it on. If you're buying this bell for a child, just know that you most likely will not receive the certificate of authenticity. If that matter to you then look elsewhere; but if it doesn't, then i'm sure you will be extremely happy with your purchase.

product_metadata.title: Polar Express Sleigh Bell Gift Set (4 Pack)
features: This is THE First Gift of Christmas. The gift set contains a large silver sleigh bell with premium leather harness strap, velvet gift bag, the red and white striped gift box, the bow and ribbon, and a unique Certificate of Authenticity that has the name of the elf who made your bell, the reindeer who flies with the bell on its harness, etc.

Watch your child's eyes light up when they open this gift on Christmas morning. There is no bell out there more true to the movie and book than this one! No detail has been spared, from the size and shape of the bell, to the size and shape of the box, the stripe pattern on the box (striped inside and out), the bow and the ribbon.
Add our ROUND TRIP ticket or BELIEVE punched ticket at a discounted price when you order this item!

NOTE: while we want you to look around for the perfect bell for you, we are confident you will settle on this bell. No other bell has all the details so true to the original from the bell to the gift box.
Bell is 3" long top to bottom and 2 1/4" in diameter and weighs over 5 oz and ticket is a substantial 8" x 3". The ticket has a slight sparkle to it and is antique gold.
